encoder_method_note:
Each building in the `skyline` group is a rect whose `height` attribute equals 10 times the alphabet position of one letter (A=1 … Z=26), so heights 120, 10, 190, 200 spell L-A-S-T, and reading the 17 buildings left to right gives the full message. Word boundaries are marked by the wider gaps containing trees, which split the buildings into groups of 4, 5, 2 and 6 letters. The window pattern reinforces this since each building shows exactly height/10 rows of windows; everything else (stars, moon, trees, ground) is purely decorative.
